en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural industrial complex in a snowy valley surrounded by forested hills and a river. Several large rectangular buildings, likely mill or factory buildings, stand near the water, with scattered conifer trees in the foreground. The image is vignetted in an irregular shape against a blank background. Red printed German text at the top identifies the scene as Reutte in Tyrol and mentions a former paper mill now used as an electricity plant; additional publisher information appears at the bottom.
